gaps.accepted_domain_recovery: Recover the native domain baseline and show that each candidate preserves its declared order and boundary behavior before outcome contact.
gaps.held_out_incremental_prediction: Only after the scale contract survives, compare held-out calibration and prediction; otherwise publish non-identifiability.
gaps.independent_replication: An external custodian audits the scale contract, reruns any lawful frozen comparison, and publishes nulls.
gaps.kill_criterion: No conclusion survives admissible reparameterization, rank reversals are arbitrary, or the measures encode the desired result.
gaps.native_equations: The selected minimum convention and other conjunctive rules; a product is admissible as a ranking only under separately defended cardinal scales.
gaps.native_objects: Ordinal foresight and usable-means ranks, declared admissible transformations, and outcome; cardinal variables only if separately validated and commensurate.
gaps.no_placement_rival: No cross-factor scalar ranking, or an ordinary domain aggregator selected without D-level placement.
gaps.permutation_challenge: Reparameterize inputs over the declared admissible class and test whether the conclusion and ranking survive.
gaps.question: Does any cross-factor AND-class conclusion survive the admissible strictly increasing reparameterizations of the declared ordinal inputs?
gaps.survivor: Joint necessity and the selected minimum convention; a local product only under a defended cardinal scale.
gaps.title: Ordinal AND-class aggregation

gaps.accepted_domain_recovery: Recover resource accounting and task-performance baselines.
gaps.held_out_incremental_prediction: Predict outcome and remaining means in held-out states.
gaps.independent_replication: Independent lab repeats the measurement design.
gaps.kill_criterion: No recurrent trade-off or a simpler surface predicts as well.
gaps.native_equations: No-tradeoff, additive, nonlinear and state-dependent resource-surface rivals.
gaps.native_objects: Measured modeling cost, usable means, task state and outcome.
gaps.no_placement_rival: Ordinary resource-allocation model without Phi/V interpretation.
gaps.permutation_challenge: Exchange labels and functional forms while holding measured budgets fixed.
gaps.question: What measurable budget surface, if any, relates option-model quality, its resource cost, and remaining usable means?
gaps.survivor: Joint necessity may remain a task-specific description.
gaps.title: Foresight and usable-means surface

gaps.accepted_domain_recovery: Reproduce known control effects without an Emergentist variable.
gaps.held_out_incremental_prediction: Content-specific change in present action beyond matched controls.
gaps.independent_replication: Independent sample and analysts reproduce the effect.
gaps.kill_criterion: Effect vanishes under fair controls or does not replicate.
gaps.native_equations: Native behavioral or cognitive model selected before data contact.
gaps.native_objects: Present representations, salience, demand, reward, memory, expectancy and action.
gaps.no_placement_rival: Generic framing, salience, demand, memory or reward model.
gaps.permutation_challenge: Permute content while matching salience, demand and reward.
gaps.question: Does changing represented future content alter present selection beyond salience, demand, reward framing, memory, and expectancy?
gaps.survivor: Present models can guide ordinary present action.
gaps.title: Controlled future-content effect

gaps.accepted_domain_recovery: Both models recover training-domain behavior before intervention.
gaps.held_out_incremental_prediction: Relation-aware model predicts held-out intervention outcome.
gaps.independent_replication: Independent domain team repeats the intervention.
gaps.kill_criterion: Relations add no discrimination or fail to recover element behavior.
gaps.native_objects: Identical element inventories, intervenable relation structures and outcomes.
gaps.no_placement_rival: Feature engineering or definitional expansion without emergence language.
gaps.permutation_challenge: Randomize relation labels and structures while preserving inventories.
gaps.question: Can a relation-aware model predict an intervention better than a model with the same elements but no explicit relation structure?
gaps.survivor: D2 remains a useful configuration address.
gaps.title: Relation intervention

gaps.accepted_domain_recovery: Recover carrier, incentive, command and environment effects first.
gaps.held_out_incremental_prediction: Trace intervention predicts later selection across turnover beyond rivals.
gaps.independent_replication: A second site reproduces all five markers with bearer costs.
gaps.kill_criterion: Any marker fails or rivals absorb the intervention effect.
gaps.native_equations: Native causal or organizational models for trace and choice intervention.
gaps.native_objects: Trace, carriers, turnover, choices, recurrent bias and attributed substrate costs.
gaps.no_placement_rival: Carrier identity, incentives, direct coordination, environment or observer narrative.
gaps.permutation_challenge: Remove, scramble and replace traces and carriers separately.
gaps.question: Does a persistent shared trace survive carrier turnover and measurably reweight later choices beyond current incentives and direct coordination?
gaps.survivor: Trace-mediated coordination in its native scope.
gaps.title: Egregoreotype trace intervention

gaps.accepted_domain_recovery: Recover fixed-plan, ordinary-role, generalist-team, and standard multi-objective governance baselines before adding the placement.
gaps.held_out_incremental_prediction: Compare held-out delivery, correction, delayed harm, lock-in, and real exit against the strongest ordinary-governance rival.
gaps.independent_replication: An external team repeats the preregistered comparison with bearer costs and nulls visible.
gaps.kill_criterion: No out-of-sample gain, proxy harm or lock-in appears, or an ordinary-governance rival performs as well.
gaps.native_equations: Standard multi-objective and receding-horizon governance comparators; Rosetta labels are never measurements.
gaps.native_objects: Long and short horizons T_L and T_S, bearer vector, voluntary role assignments, tie-breakers, exit costs, tragic residue, and delivery and harm outcomes.
gaps.no_placement_rival: Transparent ordinary governance with explicit horizons, responsibilities, appeals, and exit but no Emergentist or Rosetta placement.
gaps.permutation_challenge: Swap horizons and role assignments while holding tasks, bearers, authority, and resources fixed.
gaps.question: Do nested learning and responsibility horizons with explicit bearers, tie-breakers, and exit outperform ordinary governance rivals without proxy harm or lock-in?
gaps.survivor: An explicit horizon, bearer, tie-breaker, tragic-residue, and exit record.
gaps.title: Nested-horizon coordination

gaps.accepted_domain_recovery: Recover reactive and planning performance before positing a distinct capacity.
gaps.held_out_incremental_prediction: Independent D5 measure predicts action beyond rich D4 baselines.
gaps.independent_replication: Independent lab and task family reproduce the delta.
gaps.kill_criterion: No effect beyond fair D4 baselines.
gaps.native_equations: Native model-based, model-free, memory and search baselines.
gaps.native_objects: Represented alternatives, present state, means, search, policy and action.
gaps.no_placement_rival: Ordinary model-based control or cached policy.
gaps.permutation_challenge: Manipulate future content with present state and means matched.
gaps.question: Does a separately measured capacity to represent alternatives predict action beyond rich reactive, planning, memory, and search baselines?
gaps.survivor: Model-mediated anticipation remains ordinary causal cognition.
gaps.title: Distinct counterfactual capacity

gaps.held_out_incremental_prediction: History metric predicts something beyond causal volume and search budget.
gaps.kill_criterion: Metric tracks only causal volume or model resolution.
gaps.native_equations: Native spacetime geometry plus an independently warranted history metric.
gaps.native_objects: Minkowski causal volume, model resolution and independently defined history entropy.
gaps.no_placement_rival: Ordinary spacetime volume and model-complexity accounting.
gaps.permutation_challenge: Vary model resolution independently of physical cone geometry.
gaps.question: Can history entropy be defined independently of Minkowski causal volume, model resolution, and search budget?
gaps.survivor: Physical cone and option bundle remain distinct useful objects.
gaps.title: History-bundle metric

gaps.accepted_domain_recovery: Each row recovers its lower register independently.
gaps.held_out_incremental_prediction: One frozen discriminator per seam before any census result.
gaps.independent_replication: Every row requires separate external replication.
gaps.kill_criterion: Rows are arbitrary or a proposed irreducible freedom escapes the scaffold.
gaps.native_equations: Native lower and candidate upper models for each seam.
gaps.native_objects: One declared system and candidate new freedom per crossing.
gaps.no_placement_rival: Continuous multiscale description or another rung count.
gaps.permutation_challenge: Change rung order and labels; test whether each row remains nonarbitrary.
gaps.question: Does each proposed aperture possess an independent novelty discriminator and a lower-register recovery test?
gaps.title: Five-crossing census

gaps.accepted_domain_recovery: Recover accepted theory in its tested domain before any crosswalk.
gaps.independent_replication: Independent physics group reproduces prediction and recovery.
gaps.kill_criterion: Rows permute freely, lack mechanism or fail recovery.
gaps.native_equations: Standard Model, general relativity or effective native equations as applicable.
gaps.native_objects: Native fields, states, symmetries, observables and interactions for each row.
gaps.no_placement_rival: Native theories with no Emergentist grammar.
gaps.permutation_challenge: Test all 24 row permutations and matched decorative maps.
gaps.question: Does each proposed force-affinity row recover its native theory and outperform every permutation on a quantitative discriminator?
gaps.survivor: Historical origin and D-scaffold translation only.
gaps.title: Force and freedom affinities

gaps.held_out_incremental_prediction: An observation sensitive to ontic plurality rather than epistemic support.
gaps.independent_replication: Independent foundations analysis and empirical replication if identifiable.
gaps.native_equations: Shared native formalism plus interpretation-specific predictions if any.
gaps.native_objects: Operational observations and rival quantum or cosmological interpretations.
gaps.no_placement_rival: One actual history plus epistemic uncertainty.
gaps.permutation_challenge: Exchange interpretation labels without changing observables.
gaps.question: Is there any observation that distinguishes ontic plurality of complete histories from epistemic support over alternatives?
gaps.title: Ontology-sensitive plurality

gaps.accepted_domain_recovery: All earlier row recoveries and nulls remain visible.
gaps.held_out_incremental_prediction: One novel frozen discriminator not inherited from component theories.
gaps.independent_replication: External red team, independent replication and published null route.
gaps.kill_criterion: No incremental prediction or recurring harmful overreach.
gaps.native_equations: Every native science retains its accepted equations; common dynamics must be separately supplied.
gaps.native_objects: Plural native-domain objects plus predeclared common task and consequences.
gaps.no_placement_rival: Plural native sciences with no common Emergentist placement.
gaps.permutation_challenge: Compare the complete grammar with reordered mappings and a no-placement rival.
gaps.question: Can the complete grammar make one novel frozen prediction with consequence value beyond serious plural-domain rivals?
gaps.survivor: Tier, rival, kill, receipt, repair and exit discipline.
gaps.title: Integrated worldview adequacy
